diagnosis: The Robyn WebSocket endpoint verifies the client's JWT token during the handshake, but fails to check whether the authenticated user has permission to subscribe to the specified stream_id. Any authenticated user can connect to arbitrary telemetry streams and receive confidential real-time sensor and transaction events published to that stream.
